objective: Genuine LoRA weight training for this Agent runtime's tool parameters and verified file operations
sampling: without replacement in each complete epoch; retention floor and seeded family interleaving

loss.base: assistant-only mean token cross entropy; history masked
loss.additional: mean CE per parameter, then mean across groups of each kind
loss.target_metadata: Verified exact character spans only; never appended to visible prompt
loss.unicode_and_lf_crlf_token_mapping: Complete offset coverage; fail on gaps or masked tokens

max_length_resolution: Complete train/dev runtime and official-template maximum is 2516, rounded up to 2560; no truncation or dropped long records

checkpoint_selection.metric: paired dev free generation and independent actual file-state replay
checkpoint_selection.backend: HF CUDA BF16, original FP32 norms/gates restored, greedy, 512 new tokens
checkpoint_selection.baseline: Frozen original model with zero initialized adapter, evaluated before any optimizer update
checkpoint_selection.preservation: Every scored ordinary family and tool family must retain at least the paired base's number of correct cases
checkpoint_selection.ordinary_semantics_scope: Independently computed arithmetic and deterministic language operations; does not establish open conversation preservation
checkpoint_selection.tool_overall: Strictly more independently successful tool stages than the paired base
critical_write_classes: new target CAS and exact bytes
existing target observed CAS and edited bytes
checkpoint_selection.critical_write_configuration: v4-critical-minima.json, fixed before candidate model results
checkpoint_selection.all_failed_candidates: Keep real checkpoint weights and raw evidence; refuse selected adapter export and deployment

provenance: Snapshot trainer/helpers/scorer/fixture/runtime source bytes; pin train/dev/catalog/minima hashes, all raw outputs and exact selected consumed prefix
